note: Create each entry as a Retell custom function: POST to https://ai-healthcare-front-desk-api.halo-voice-parshva.workers.dev/webhooks/retell/custom-function, timeout 10 seconds, max retries 0, no extra headers or query parameters, and 'Payload: args only' turned OFF (the Worker needs the name, args and call fields). The Worker verifies X-Retell-Signature with the RETELL_API_KEY secret and answers only calls it started itself (signed metadata) or allowlisted owner numbers. It always uses the clinic time zone, so no tool takes a timezone. Business outcomes such as a taken slot come back as HTTP 200 with success=false and a message, because Retell does not show the agent the body of a non-2xx response. Write tools are idempotent per call, so retrying with the same details never books twice. Every result may include seconds_left (time left in the call). Where 'speak_during_execution' is given, turn on 'Speak during execution' with that static sentence; otherwise leave it off. The previous search_approved_faq function is no longer used (the approved answers are in the prompt) and should be removed from the agent; the Worker still answers it for older versions.

functions.name: get_availability
functions.description: Search open appointment times. Returns up to three different options with a spoken time (and caller_time when the caller's time zone differs), plus more_available.

start_date.description: First clinic date to search, YYYY-MM-DD, taken from the calendar in the prompt.

search_days.description: How many calendar days to search from start_date. 1 for a single day; 5 for 'this week' or 'soonest'; up to 14.

time_of_day.description: Morning is before noon, afternoon from noon (clinic time).

earliest_time.description: Only times at or after this clinic time, HH:MM 24-hour (for 'after 3' or 'anything later').

provider.description: Only when the caller asks for a specific doctor.

functions.name: create_appointment
functions.description: Book one of the times returned by get_availability. Returns the reference, reference_spoken and the booked time.

patient_name.description: The person's name exactly as the caller gave or spelled it (any name; letters only).

start_at.description: The start_at of the chosen slot, copied exactly from get_availability.

provider.description: The provider of the chosen slot, copied from get_availability.

functions.name: lookup_appointment
functions.description: Find upcoming bookings by name, or one booking by reference (with the name to verify, if known). Returns up to five appointments with spoken times; match tells how the name matched.

booking_reference.description: The booking reference: DEMO-4812, or just its four digits.

patient_name.description: The person's name exactly as the caller gave or spelled it (any name; letters only).

functions.name: join_waitlist
functions.description: Add a person to the waitlist for a visit type and preferred date. Creates a staff follow-up only; it does not book or send anything.

patient_name.description: The person's name exactly as the caller gave or spelled it (any name; letters only).

preferred_date.description: Preferred clinic date, YYYY-MM-DD, from the calendar in the prompt.

functions.name: request_staff_followup
functions.description: Log a staff follow-up task. Only the request type and name are stored; never pass the caller's details or reasons.

request_type.description: callback = someone should call back (also for clinical questions); refill = prescription refill request; records = medical records request; billing = billing or insurance question; documents = help with a referral document; faq = a question with no approved answer; accessibility = accessibility or interpreter support.

patient_name.description: The person's name exactly as the caller gave or spelled it (any name; letters only).
